name: patch9-ui
description: Build, slice, and repair responsive game UI in this project with the shared Patch9Button/Patch9Surface renderer. Use whenever creating or changing a HUD, main menu, modal, panel, framed button, UI atlas crop, or a UI overlay that must stay clickable inside ScalableContainer. Covers FSD placement, asset slicing, Patch9 inset configuration, interaction rules, and headed validation.

findings.excerpt: 1. Run `npx eslint` on the changed feature and route.
